title: Structural cutting and recombining in layered sodium dysprosium phosphonate: key roles of flexible pyrazinyl hydrazone molecular tools

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, C10H7PO3H2 (41.6 mg, 0.20 mmol) and Dy(SCN)3·6H2O (133.8 mg, 0.30 mmol) were dissolved in H2O/CH3OH (1:4, 30 mL). Solid NaOH (2.4 mg, 0.06 mmol) was added with stirring at ambient temperature. The yellow solution was stirred at 80 °C for 12 h. H2opch (81.1 mg, 0.30 mmol) was then added and the mixture was stirred for another 1 h at 80 °C, giving a clear orange-brown solution. The solution was transferred to 30 mL sealed glassware and kept in a vacuum drying oven at 110 °C. Dark-red block-like crystals of 1 formed after 5 days.
synthesis.time: 12 h at 80 °C, then 1 h at 80 °C after ligand addition; crystals after 5 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed 30 mL glassware in vacuum drying oven
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: orange-brown solution sealed and heated at 110 °C; dark-red block crystals isolated

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility of the Na5Dy6 cluster shows χMT = 83.89 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K (expected 85.02 for six DyIII), a minimum of 67.44 cm3 K mol−1 at 9.0 K, then a rise to 69.92 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K, consistent with intramolecular ferromagnetic Dy···Dy interactions. Magnetization at 2.0 K and 70 kOe reaches 24.39 μB, well below the 60 μB saturation limit, with nonsuperimposed M vs H/T curves indicating anisotropy. Under zero dc field, 1 shows slow magnetic relaxation without clear χ″ frequency peaks in the same way as 2; fitting ln(χ″/χ′) vs 1/T gives Δ = 3.1 K and τ0 = 3.9×10−4 s. A multi-process fit of ln τ vs 1/T yields Δ = 22.9 K, τ0 = 1.3×10−6 s, A = 2.78 s−1 K−1, τQTM = 3.1 ms, C = 0.0029 s−1 K−4.36, n = 4.36.

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, C10H7PO3H2 (41.6 mg, 0.20 mmol) was added to Dy(OAc)3·6H2O (53.3 mg, 0.15 mmol) and CH3ONa (5.4 mg, 0.10 mmol) in CH3OH/CH3CN (1:1, 30 mL). The mixture was refluxed for 2 h below 90 °C, then incubated at 60 °C for 50 min. H2EDDC (29.8 mg, 0.10 mmol) and H2opch (40.5 mg, 0.15 mmol) were added slowly to give a clear pale-yellow solution. The solution was transferred to 30 mL sealed glassware and kept in a vacuum drying oven at 110 °C. Pale-yellow hexagon-like plates of 2 formed after one week.
synthesis.time: 2 h reflux, 50 min at 60 °C; crystals after one week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux then sealed 30 mL glassware in vacuum drying oven
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: pale-yellow solution sealed and heated at 110 °C; pale-yellow hexagonal plates isolated

properties.summary: The 2D Na4Dy8 phosphonate shows χMT = 109.99 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K (expected 113.36 for eight DyIII) and a monotonic drop to 86.03 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K, attributed to depopulation of MJ sublevels and possible antiferromagnetic interactions. Magnetization at 2.0 K and 70 kOe is 19.12 μB versus an 80 μB saturation expectation. Unlike 1, 2 exhibits clear frequency-dependent χ″ peaks (especially 1000–10000 Hz) under zero dc field, characteristic of slow relaxation. Cole–Cole α ≤ 0.19. Multi-process fitting of ln τ vs 1/T gives Δ = 19.6 K, τ0 = 2.9×10−6 s, A = 2.92 s−1 K−1, B = 0.021 s−1, C = 0.0041 s−1 K−4.42, n = 4.42, with Orbach dominance above ~6 K and Raman/direct/QTM contributions at lower T.
